title: LLM Semantic Caching with Graph-Based Invalidation in Transactional Microservices — Replication Package
description: Replication package for transactional graph-based semantic caching: PostgreSQL/pgvector + Redis gateway, GPTCache baseline harness, 184-run main campaign (including 6 live Claude Haiku 4.5 runs), and 178-run cross-platform replication with independent content-level fact checker.
